topic: improving a home office workspace over several months

gold_fact.text: User planned to switch to a standing desk by March and did follow through, buying and setting one up.

question: Did the user end up switching to a standing desk like they intended?
gold_answer: Yes — they followed through and set one up.

traps.description: User earlier voices doubt about standing desks being worth it, which could mislead a system into saying they did not switch.
A separate unrelated plan (new monitor) is mentioned and never completed, to tempt confusion about which plan was fulfilled.

rationale: Answer requires the intention's fulfilled status; the earlier doubt (opinion) and a parallel unfulfilled plan are distractors a w/e/o store cannot disambiguate by lifecycle.
